description: Source code for the LayerSnapshot class in the Android surfaceflinger frontend, managing layer state, visibility, effects, and rendering properties.

classes.name: LayerSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of a layer's state for rendering, including properties like visibility, effects, and buffer info.

methods.name: isOpaqueFormat
methods.description: Determines if a given pixel format is opaque, considering device-specific formats.

methods.name: hasBufferOrSidebandStream
methods.description: Checks if the layer has an associated buffer or sideband stream.

methods.name: drawShadows
methods.description: Checks if the layer has shadow effects to draw.

methods.name: fillsColor
methods.description: Checks if the layer fills a color without buffers or streams.

methods.name: hasBlur
methods.description: Checks if the layer has blur effects.

methods.name: hasEffect
methods.description: Determines if the layer has any visual effects like color, shadows, or blur.

methods.name: hasSomethingToDraw
methods.description: Checks if the layer has any drawable content or effects.

methods.name: isContentOpaque
methods.description: Determines if the layer's content is fully opaque based on buffers, format, and color.

methods.name: isHiddenByPolicy
methods.description: Checks if the layer is hidden due to policy or transform issues.

methods.name: getIsVisible
methods.description: Determines if the layer is visible based on various flags and effects.

methods.name: getIsVisibleReason
methods.description: Provides a string explanation for the layer's visibility status.

methods.name: canReceiveInput
methods.description: Checks if the layer can receive input events.

methods.name: isTransformValid
methods.description: Validates if a given transform matrix is valid (non-zero determinant, not inf or nan).

methods.name: hasInputInfo
methods.description: Checks if the layer has input-related information.

methods.name: getDebugString
methods.description: Generates a debug string representing the layer's current state.

methods.name: sourceBounds
methods.description: Returns the source bounds of the layer, either from external texture or geometry bounds.
